source: Source: Audemars Piguet; Watches by SJX

slides.label: The dial
slides.headline: Red that fades to black
slides.body: The centre is bright red, and the edge turns deep burgundy, almost black.

slides.label: What it is
slides.headline: A metal cooled like glass
slides.body: Bulk metallic glass is cooled so fast its atoms never line up in neat rows.

slides.label: The size
slides.headline: Wide, with a titanium case
slides.body: It is 39 mm wide, 8.1 mm thick and winds itself.

slides.label: Rare
slides.headline: Only one made for charity
slides.body: A single watch in this metal went to the Only Watch charity auction.
